posts.text: What's the most annoying part of researching an Indian stock? — My workflow is fairly boring, but it cut my tab count a lot. I start with 10 years of financials and the peer table on Screener, and judge ROCE against the company’s own history and its 3–4 closest peers rather than as an absolute number. 18% is strong for a capital-heavy business but fairly ordinary for an asset-light one. posts.text: What's the most annoying part of researching an Indian stock? — I research Indian stocks regularly, and my process is held together by tabs and spreadsheets. These are the things that drive me up the wall: • The data is scattered: financials on one site, filings on BSE/NSE, concall transcripts somewhere else, annual reports as 300-page PDFs • Screeners give numbers, not meaning: ROCE is 18%, but is that good or bad for this sector? • It’s hard to see what changed: which quarter, which line item, which announcement actually mattered • Clean historical price data for backtesting is either paid o…
